Transformer temperature directly affects the life of the insulating material.

Maximum temperature rise limits are specified for the both oil and winding 
 temperature.

In the daily inspection, check not only that temperatures are held within the 
 maximum limit, but also that the temperature lies in a satisfactory range in 
 relation to their values in the test report, load condition and ambient 
 temperature.

Overloading of transformer should be made only in accordance with the 
 applicable standard.

 others.
